headlines.title: Meta wants your next gadget to be Muse-infused
headlines.summary: Meta wants Muse in your TV and your toaster, so it's giving the code away for free.

headlines.title: Sanders introduces bill to ban the federal government from using Flock
headlines.summary: The proposed legislation would extend to all automotica license plate readers.

headlines.title: Why Western Digital and Seagate are seeing big stock drops today
headlines.summary: Investors are worried that Toshiba will boost its production of a key AI storage product, potentially hurting the strong pricing power that Western Digital and Seagate currently enjoy.

headlines.title: Cerebras stock hits post-IPO low, tumbling 20% for the week on Nvidia pressure and lockup expiration
headlines.summary: Cerebras shares hit an all-time low due to pressure from chip giant Nvidia, plus a post-lockup selloff.

headlines.title: Tesla sold a lot more EVs than Wall Street expected, and the stock is surging
headlines.summary: EV giant Tesla had the best three-month period for vehicle sales this year, but it was less than a year ago.

headlines.title: I’m 71 and still working. I earn $108,000 a year. Am I doing the right thing?
headlines.summary: “I have $152,000 in my IRA and Roth accounts.”

headlines.title: DOJ says it will not reopen criminal probe into former Fed Chair Powell
headlines.summary: The confirmation comes after the Fed's inspector general report that said there were no grounds for a criminal referral over the mismanaged headquarters renovation.

headlines.title: Falling wages, soaring energy prices and inflation: It’s beginning to look a lot like the 1970s
headlines.summary: Is it time to dust off the financial playbook from that dismal decade?

headlines.title: Sean Parker is rebuilding Stability AI around music
headlines.summary: Sean Parker, who once taught the music industry what asking for forgiveness looks like, is now back with the labels' blessing and money.

headlines.title: Anthropic to invest $100 million to train AI engineer talent
headlines.summary: Anthropic will invest $100 million to train nearly 10,000 AI engineers, partnering with a number of consulting firms.

headlines.title: Why mixing politics with your stock portfolio might be costing you money
headlines.summary: Data shows that partisan ETFs result in higher fees and lower market returns

headlines.title: Does AI have a soul? Pope Leo and Anthropic clash.
headlines.summary: The Vatican has laid a moral blueprint for the technology, with Pope Leo maintaining that “algorithms lack the spark of humanity.”
